name: 霞之谷的大怪鸟
nameEn: Roc from the Valley of Haze
desc: 这张卡从手卡送去墓地时，这张卡加入卡组洗切。
faq: Because this effect is a mandatory Trigger Effect, you cannot "miss the timing" with it. So even if you send "Roc from the Valley of Haze" to the Graveyard as a cost, or in the middle of a chain, it will still return to your hand (after resolving the current series of events).
